pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, moderately jagged polygons with soft to medium pixel gradients at the edges. Smaller, more rounded patches are concentrated toward the hindquarters, while larger, elongated patches appear on the lateral flank and neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Network of light cream-colored negative space forming a continuous web. Pathways exhibit variable pixel thickness, narrowing at many tri-nodal junctions. Continuity is maintained across the visible field.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Fine-textured, low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the neck ridge, representing the visible mane against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, dark horizontal indentation or mark is visible on the posterior left flank, distinct from the surrounding pelage pattern.
